(#{id}, #{node.code}, #{node.parentCode}, #{node.level}, #{node.name}, CAST(#{node.sourceMetadata,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB))

mapper.sql: FROM (SELECT code, parent_code, level, name FROM reference_nodes WHERE release_id = #{current,jdbcType=BIGINT}) old FULL JOIN (SELECT code, parent_code, level, name FROM reference_nodes WHERE release_id = #{draft}) candidate ON candidate.code = old.code WHERE (old.name, old.parent_code, old.level) IS DISTINCT FROM (candidate.name, candidate.parent_code, candidate.level)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE old.code IS NULL) AS added, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE old.code IS NOT NULL AND candidate.code IS NOT NULL) AS changed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE candidate.code IS NULL) AS removed

SELECT COALESCE(old.code, candidate.code) AS code, CASE WHEN old.code IS NULL THEN 'ADDED' WHEN candidate.code IS NULL THEN 'REMOVED' ELSE 'CHANGED' END AS kind, old.name AS previous_name, candidate.name AS next_name, old.parent_code AS previous_parent_code, candidate.parent_code AS next_parent_code, old.level AS previous_level, candidate.level AS next_level
ORDER BY code LIMIT 40
